newsitem.title: USA: First Security splits stock, boosts div.
newsitem.headline: First Security splits stock, boosts div.

text.p: First Security Corp said Monday it declared a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend payable May 15 to shareholders of record May 12.
The company said that as a result of the split, shareholders will receive one additional share of stock for every two shares sold.
The company said it also increased its regular cash dividend 11 percent to $0.17 per common share, after adjusting for the stock split.
The company said the increase brings the annual dividend rate to $0.68 per share compared with $0.61 before the increase.
The company said this is its third dividend increase in 18 months. Since January 1996, its dividend has been increased 36.6 percent.

The company said the increased dividend will be paid June 2 to shareholders of record May 16. At market price adjusted for the split, the annual dividend yield on First Security common stock is approximately 3 percent.
